name: clamav-onaccess
description: ClamAV on-access scanning: opening an infected file is blocked (fanotify; edit /etc/clamav/onaccess-paths)

files.content:
# Managed by `ziroctl plugin enable clamav-onaccess`. clamonacc asks clamd (local socket) about every
# open in the watched paths and denies the open when the file is infected.
LocalSocket /run/clamav/clamd.sock
# Must match clamd.conf: clamonacc never watches clamd's own temp directory
TemporaryDirectory /var/lib/clamav/tmp
OnAccessPrevention yes
OnAccessExcludeUname clamav
OnAccessMaxFileSize 25M
OnAccessMaxThreads 2
OnAccessCurlTimeout 10000
OnAccessDenyOnError no

# Directories scanned on access, one per line (your edits are kept across upgrades).
/home
/root
/tmp
/var/tmp
/srv
/var/lib/ziro/volumes
